scientific_integrity: Proof and full dual vertex enumeration given. Self-review only; finite exact checks independently test bounded examples and do not prove unbounded claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite real Lipschitz-free spaces with at least two clusters, each internally equilateral of positive diameter below the common intercluster distance. Does not cover nested hierarchies, within-cluster unequal distances, or full face lattices. Numerical enumeration supplements but does not replace proof. Independent mathematical review has not occurred.
title: Facet enumeration for finite block-equilateral ultrametrics with independent cluster scales
